existing_features.title: Replace the existing single “Start Time” selector on the Add Availability UI (the Add Availability modal/page where a user selects a start time) with three dropdowns: Hour, Minute, and AM/PM, and use these inputs to produce the same stored `time` string format currently used by availability (e.g., "8:00 AM").
Move the light/dark mode toggle out of the profile dropdown and into a dedicated header button positioned immediately to the left of the profile icon/menu in the top bar.

new_feature_requests.summary: Replace the start-time selector in the Add Availability modal with three dropdowns: hour, minute, and AM/PM
Move the light/dark mode toggle to a dedicated button in the header, positioned to the left of the profile icon (not inside the profile dropdown)

projectName: Split Add Availability start-time into hour/minute/AM-PM dropdowns and move theme toggle into header
